Грузовая этикетка IATA: пояснения
Название авиакомпании, номер авианакладной, пункт назначения и основной штрихкод. Эти четыре элемента требует резолюция IATA 606.

Origin, transfer points, piece number, weight из the piece, total pieces, total weight, handling information, house waybill details and other information. Fill in what your airline or handler asks for.

Code 128 с 16 цифрами: 3-значный префикс авиакомпании, 8-значный серийный номер авианакладной, разделительный ноль и 4-значный номер места. Для авианакладной 176-12345675 место 3 кодируется как 1761234567500003.

Yes. Choose or drop a PDF, JPG or PNG из the air waybill and the tool fills in the airline, AWB number, origin, destination, total pieces and weight. Optional details such as transfer points and handling information are left blank for you to add if you want them. PDFs from airline and e-AWB systems read best. Scans and photos work too if they are sharp and straight. Fields in green passed our checks, fields in amber need a look. The file is read on your own device and never uploaded.

Yes. Each piece carries its own label, and the piece number is part из the barcode, so every label in a shipment is different. You can print a range, for example pieces 11 to 20, if you are labelling in batches.

The last digit из an 8-digit air waybill serial is normally the first seven digits divided by 7, taking the remainder. If it does not match, the number may have been mistyped. Check it against your air waybill.
